db_engine.description: Database engine to use (e.g., mysql, postgres)

db_url.description: Database connection URL in format: engine://user:pass@host/dbname

listen_addr.description: IP address for SIP service to bind to (e.g., 192.168.1.10, *, 0.0.0.0)

workers.description: Number of worker processes to spawn (CPU cores ≈ workers)

fork_mode.description: Forking mode: '1' = fork per worker; '0' = single process

log_level.description: Kamailio log level (0=EMERG, 6=DEBUG); 3=NOTICE is typical for prod

tls_key.description: Path to TLS private key file

tls_ca_list.description: Path to CA certificate bundle for client verification (optional)

tls_method.description: TLS method/version (e.g., TLSv1_2, TLSv1_3, SSLv23 for auto-negotiation)

auth_realm.description: SIP authentication realm/domain used in 401 Unauthorized responses

trace_destination.description: Destination for trace logging (e.g., file://, stderr://)

trace_local.description: Enable tracing of local messages (e.g., from other modules)

rport_header.description: Custom header name to append R-port in NAT scenarios

rport_value.description: Value to set for R-port header (often just 'rport')
